changelog.name: PrismLock 1.0.6
changelog.body:
## PrismLock 1.0.6

- Centered the Keqing Electro, Appear and Disappear compositions using their visual bounds while preserving scale and timing.
- Prevented the first authentication from racing the initial configuration load, which could briefly show Samsung's default touch animation.
- Kept the 120 fps playback, API 102 hooks, and existing artwork catalog intact.

Install the APK, then restart the phone once so the biometrics process loads the updated module.

changelog.name: PrismLock 1.0.5
changelog.body:
## PrismLock 1.0.5

**Requires a framework supporting modern libxposed API 102**, as in 1.0.4. Update in place, check the module's activation/scope, then restart the scoped process or reboot so Samsung loads the updated module. Your settings and selections are retained.

### Artwork and catalog

- Add Keqing's static symbol with light/AOD variants, the complete electro effect, and appear/disappear motion styles.
- Compare decoded images and complete animation sequences to consolidate repeated visual designs. The catalog now shows **30 fingerprint families and 19 effect families**, with **60 selectable styles**; alternate colors and meaningful motion remain available inside each family.
- Preserve all previous selection identifiers. The old Outline tag resolves to the sharper Bubble artwork; other retained styles keep their own image data and source timing.
- Use a native style picker and align title/variant columns with thumbnails and selection markers.

### Fluidity and efficiency

- Retarget all **74 built-in compositions**, including light/AOD resources, to a **120fps playback timebase** with temporal interpolation and unchanged durations. Source images remain 30/60fps artwork; this does not invent captured frames or guarantee 120 rendered frames on every device.
- Request up to 120Hz for the app at the current display resolution when supported. Actual refresh depends on display, power policy, renderer and device load. Static icons remain static.
- Share concurrent thumbnail requests, deliver cached wallpaper immediately, and rebind only affected visible rows.
- Release idle background worker threads and recycle canceled, unpublished preview bitmaps without removing visual effects.
- Keep automatic foreground update checks and the signed in-place installer.

### Validation

- **83 automated tests passed**; catalog integrity, alias/style compatibility, old selections, timing preservation, interpolation, worker lifecycle, updates and API 102 hooks are covered. Debug/release lint completed without errors; release signing and APK alignment verified.
- Installed and checked on Galaxy S23. The installed file exactly matches this release artifact; the user confirmed functionality. Three navigation/scroll tests recorded **3 janky frames out of 915**, ~120Hz frame intervals and 8ms p95 in the two warm runs (14ms on the first run). Idle named PrismLock workers terminated. These are smoke-test results, not an all-device performance guarantee.

Download **PrismLock-1.0.5.apk** below. Source ZIP/TAR archives are not installable apps. The APK uses the existing official release certificate.

changelog.name: PrismLock 1.0.4
changelog.body:
## Requirements and upgrading

**This version requires a framework supporting modern libxposed API 102.** Legacy-only Xposed/LSPosed frameworks cannot load PrismLock 1.0.4; update the framework before upgrading the module. Version 1.0.3 remains the last legacy release.

After upgrading, check that PrismLock is enabled for `com.samsung.android.biometrics.app.setting`, then restart the scoped process or reboot. A Samsung process still running the old module retains the previous scaling/clipping behavior until it restarts. Ordinary icon/effect selections still save automatically.

## Changes

- Fully migrate to libxposed 102.0.0 and modern module registration.
- Improve app responsiveness with recycled catalog rows, asynchronous thumbnails and display-sized wallpaper decoding. Preserve the existing appearance, catalog and visual effects.
- Fix enlarged OxygenOS/custom icon glow clipping on compatible Samsung Lottie versions by allowing artwork outside composition/parent bounds. Restore Samsung's clipping when custom artwork is disabled, without changing sensor/touch geometry. Give enlarged previews enough space for the full glow.
- Move hook configuration loading and artwork preparation off Samsung's UI thread, retaining complete snapshots and immediate configuration-change notifications.
- Check stable updates in the background on every foreground entry and offer them on the current screen without opening Settings. Share concurrent requests and retry failures immediately.
- Keep PNG/Lottie imports, light/AOD variants, size controls, themes and the signed update installer.

## Validation

- 61 automated tests passed, covering API 102 hooks, caches/tint/variants/imports, clipping restoration, catalog/previews, startup update offers and installer callbacks.
- All 57 catalog entries validated; debug/release lint completed without errors. Release certificate and APK alignment verified.
- Installed and checked on Galaxy S23 (SM-S911B), reported Android 17 / API 37, LSPosed 2.2.1. Confirmed API 102 hook loading. Three navigation/scroll smoke tests recorded 1 janky frame out of 463 rendered frames, with 95th-percentile frame times of 5–6 ms. This sample does not establish all-model performance or compatibility.

Download **PrismLock-1.0.4.apk** below. Source archives are not installable apps. The APK uses the existing official release key and updates in place while preserving settings.

readme:
PrismLock

Fingerprint icons and touch animations for Samsung devices.

[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/AurelioMo/prismlock?label=Download&color=blue&logo=github)](https://github.com/AurelioMo/prismlock/releases) [![LSPosed](https://img.shields.io/badge/LSPosed-Module-orange)](https://github.com/LSPosed/LSPosed) [![Build](https://github.com/AurelioMo/prismlock/actions/workflows/build.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/AurelioMo/prismlock/actions/workflows/build.yml) [![Source](https://img.shields.io/badge/Source-Available-222222?logo=github)](https://github.com/AurelioMo/prismlock/tree/main/app) PrismLock is an Xposed / LSPosed module that replaces fingerprint icons and touch effects on Samsung One UI. Choose a design from the built-in catalog or import your own PNG or Lottie artwork. Changes save automatically. The module hooks Samsung's fingerprint asset loader instead of modifying a system APK. That is the same device-independent technique used by RingPrint: it works across Samsung devices and One UI builds, not only on one model or firmware version. ## Download **[Download the latest APK from Releases](https://github.com/AurelioMo/prismlock/releases).** Open the newest release, expand **Assets**, and download `PrismLock-*.apk`. The source ZIP/TAR files are not installable apps. Current version: **1.0.6**. ## Compatibility | Component | Requirements | | --- | --- | | Module framework | LSPosed / compatible framework with modern libxposed API 102 support | | Devices | Samsung One UI with an in-display fingerprint sensor | | Android | 8.0 or newer (API 26+) | | Module scope | `com.samsung.android.biometrics.app.setting` | | Reference device | Galaxy S23 / SM-S911B | PrismLock does not target a specific Samsung model. It intercepts the fingerprint resources Samsung requests at runtime, so the same APK works across One UI devices. ## Installation 1. Download and install the APK from **[Releases](https://github.com/AurelioMo/prismlock/releases)**. 2. Use a framework supporting **libxposed API 102**, activate **PrismLock**, and select only the scope listed above. If upgrading from 1.0.3 or older, recheck module activation after the API migration. Restart the scoped process or reboot so Samsung loads the new module code; an already running legacy process retains its old clipping behavior until restarted. 3. Follow LSPosed's activation/restart requirements. 4. Open PrismLock and select a fingerprint and animation. There is no Apply step. 5. If you use LockStar, turn off its fingerprint effect to avoid overlapping effects. If you previously used the old `com.fpring.samsung` research package, uninstall it before enabling PrismLock. The packages are different and preferences do not migrate. ## Updates PrismLock checks GitHub Releases in the background whenever the app enters the foreground. A newer stable version is offered directly on the current screen; **Settings → App → Updates** also lets you check manually. Concurrent checks share one network request, and a failed request can be retried immediately. The APK is downloaded directly from GitHub and installed in place. Rooted devices use a silent `pm install`; otherwise Android's system installer asks for confirmation. Your settings and selections are preserved. ## Features - Built-in library of **30 fingerprint families** and **19 touch-effect families**, including Keqing, with alternate color/motion styles grouped inside each family. - Independent fingerprint and effect selection with automatic saving. - Native style picker for shared designs; old selections and alternate colors remain available. - Built-in 120fps playback timelines with temporal interpolation and unchanged durations; up to 120Hz UI refresh on supported displays. - Aligned title/style columns, coalesced thumbnail loading and idle-expiring background workers. - Color, black/light-mode and white/AOD variants for Prism, Vortex, Orbit and Neon. - PNG and Lottie imports for light and dark/AOD modes. - Separate fingerprint and animation previews with visible-bound size normalization. - English interface with system, light and dark appearance. - Smaller **0.8-second Aqua effect** with a transparent final frame. - Customization switch to pass through to Samsung's default visual resources. - Modern libxposed API 102 integration with background configuration loading. - Recycled catalog rows and asynchronous thumbnail/wallpaper loading. - Enlarged icon glows can extend beyond the Lottie artboard on compatible Samsung renderers. - In-app GitHub update checker and installer, with automatic foreground checks. The module changes visual resources only. It does not change authentication, enrollment, illumination masks, brightness control or sensor behavior. ## Screenshots | Fingerprints | Animations | Settings | | :---: | :---: | :---: | | | | | ## Source and build Requires JDK 21, Android SDK platform 36 and Python 3.10+ for catalog validation. Gradle 8.13 is pinned in the checked-in wrapper. ```sh export ANDROID_HOME=/path/to/your/android-sdk python3 scripts/check_catalog.py ./gradlew --no-daemon assembleDebug ``` On Windows use `gradlew.bat`. The debug APK is in `app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk`. For signed distribution builds, follow [release signing](docs/signing.md); never commit credentials or keystores. ```text app/ Android application, hooks and runtime artwork docs/ Architecture, release signing, testing and provenance gradle/wrapper/ Pinned build wrapper scripts/ Catalog validation and icon generation .github/ CI and issue/PR templates ``` See [architecture](docs/architecture.md), [release signing](docs/signing.md), [release validation](docs/testing.md), [contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md), [security](SECURITY.md) and [changelog](CHANGELOG.md). ## Credits Developer: **[AurelioMo](https://github.com/AurelioMo)**. Report bugs and suggestions through **[Issues](https://github.com/AurelioMo/prismlock/issues)**. Original catalog reference and artwork: **custombeta / Fingerprint Catalog**. Samsung integration research: **ELPEDR / RingPrint**. Aqua animation, Prism/Vortex/Orbit/Neon artwork and the PrismLock logo were supplied for this project. Samsung resources retain their respective ownership. PrismLock is not affiliated with Samsung, Xiaomi, Good Lock or LSPosed. Third-party materials are credited here and in [third-party credits](docs/third-party-notices.md). They remain the property of their respective owners and are not relicensed by this repository.

内置**30个指纹系列**和**19个触摸效果系列**的库，包括刻青，每个系列内分组有交替的颜色/动作风格。 - 独立的指纹和效果选择并自动保存。 - 用于共享设计的本机样式选择器；旧的选择和替代颜色仍然可用。 - 内置 120fps 播放时间线，具有时间插值和不变的持续时间；在受支持的显示器上，UI 刷新率高达 120Hz。 - 对齐标题/样式列、合并缩略图加载和空闲过期返回地勤人员。 - Prism、Vortex、Orbit 和 Neon 的彩色、黑色/灯光模式和白色/AOD 变体。 - 用于明暗/AOD 模式的 PNG 和 Lottie 导入。 - 通过可见边界尺寸标准化来分离指纹和动画预览。 - 系统英文界面，浅色和深色外观。 - 较小的 **0.8 秒 Aqua 效果**，具有透明的最终帧。 - 自定义开关可传递至三星的默认视觉资源。 - 现代 libxpose API 102 与后台配置加载集成。 - 回收目录行和异步缩略图/壁纸加载。 - 放大的图标发光可以延伸到兼容的三星渲染器上的 Lottie 画板之外。 - 应用内 GitHub 更新检查器和安装程序，具有自动前台检查功能。 该模块仅更改视觉资源。它不会改变身份验证， 登记、照明掩模、亮度控制或传感器行为。 ## 截图 |指纹|动画 |设置| | :---: | :---: | :---: | | | | | ## 来源和构建 需要 JDK 21、Android SDK 平台 36 和 Python 3.10+ 进行目录验证。 Gradle 8.13 固定在签入的包装器中。 ````嘘 导出 ANDROID_HOME=/path/to/your/android-sdk python3脚本/check_catalog.py ./gradlew --no-daemon assembleDebug ```` 在 Windows 上使用“gradlew.bat”。调试 APK 位于 `app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk`。对于签名的发行版本，请遵循 [发布签名](docs/signing.md);切勿提交凭据或密钥库。 ````文本 app/ Android 应用程序、挂钩和运行时图稿 文档/架构、发布签名、测试和出处 gradle/wrapper/ 固定构建包装器 脚本/目录验证和图标生成 .github/ CI 和问题/PR 模板 ```` 请参阅[架构](docs/architecture.md)、[发布签名](docs/signing.md)、 [发布验证](docs/testing.md)、[贡献](CONTRIBUTING.md)、 [安全](SECURITY.md) 和 [变更日志](CHANGELOG.md)。 ## 学分 开发者：**[AurelioMo](https://github.com/AurelioMo)**。 通过**[问题](https://github.com/AurelioMo/prismlock/issues)**报告错误和建议。 原始目录参考和插图：**custombeta / Fingerprint Catalog**。 三星集成研究：**ELPEDR / RingPrint**。 提供了 Aqua 动画、Prism/Vortex/Orbit/Neon 艺术作品和 PrismLock 徽标 对于这个项目。三星资源保留各自的所有权。 PrismLock 不隶属于三星、小米、Good Lock 或 LSPoded。 第三方材料记入此处和 [第三方积分](docs/third-party-notices.md)。它们仍然是以下人的财产 它们各自的所有者，并且不被此存储库重新许可。
